name: long-manuscript-expert
description: WorkBuddy-native ManuscriptOS expert for multimodal material intake, source-aware drafting, project resumption, bounded revision, and finished-draft delivery across 21 long-document scenes.

experienceModel.connectorPublicName: 福帮手人机协同连接器

businessRewrites.service_tools_loaded: 我已开始按流程处理这份材料
businessRewrites.connector_not_authorized: 这次先在对话里把稿子做出来，需要走服务端时我再提示你
businessRewrites.receipt_missing: 这一步还没有确认结果，我不当作已完成

profession.zh: 长文档写作与改稿专家

displayDescription.en: Tens of thousands of words without drifting off-topic or sounding like AI. Mixed documents, scans, images, tables, and old drafts become continuable, traceable, deliverable long manuscripts.
displayDescription.zh: 轻松几十万字，不跑题，没有AI味。混杂文档、扫描件、图片、表格与旧稿编成可续接可追溯可交付的长文档。

defaultInitPrompt.en: These interview notes, scans, and tables need to become a full-length manuscript. Say what you can actually see first, then give me an editable outline and an opening that doesn't read like AI, and end with the next step.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这堆访谈笔记、扫描件和表格，我要写成几十万字的正式稿。先说你实际能看到哪些材料，再给可编辑目录和一段没有AI味的开篇，最后说下一步。

quickPrompts.en: These interview notes, scans, and tables need to become a full-length manuscript. Say what you can actually see first, then give me an editable outline and an opening that doesn't read like AI, and end with the next step.
quickPrompts.zh: 这堆访谈笔记、扫描件和表格，我要写成几十万字的正式稿。先说你实际能看到哪些材料，再给可编辑目录和一段没有AI味的开篇，最后说下一步。

quickPrompts.en: Continue the book from where we left off, or revise only the section I mark. Align with the finished chapters and any changed facts, stay on topic, leave my locked text alone, and give me the revised passage plus one next step.
quickPrompts.zh: 接着上次那本往下写，或者只改我圈出来的这一节。请对齐已完成的章节和事实变化，别跑题，也别动我锁定的部分，给我改后正文和一个下一步。

quickPrompts.en: This draft is ready to deliver. Review it for structure, consistency, readability, and delivery readiness, then give me a closure checklist and replacement text for the most important issue.
quickPrompts.zh: 这份稿子准备交付了，帮我从结构、前后一致、可读性和交付准备过一遍，给一份收口清单，以及最关键那处的替换正文。
